subject: Animation
title: Pixar's Short Films: The Training Ground
description: A quick, practical guide to Pixar's Short Films: The Training Ground.

hook.text: Before every Pixar feature, a short film plays in theaters. These shorts are more important than they seem.

buildup.text: Pixar uses short films to let emerging directors practice leading a project with lower stakes.

discovery.text: The short Bao was directed by Domee Shi, who later directed the feature Turning Red.

twist.text: Some shorts test risky ideas Pixar might later use in features, serving as creative laboratories.

climax.text: The shorts program nurtures talent and keeps Pixar's creative pipeline full of fresh voices.

punchline.text: Five-minute films build the directors of tomorrow.

quiz.question: Why does Pixar continue making short films?
options: They are more profitable than features
They serve as training grounds for emerging directors and testing labs for new ideas
They are required by Disney's contract

details.summary: Pixar produces short films that screen before features, giving emerging directors and artists opportunities to lead creative projects. These shorts have won multiple Academy Awards and serve as a training ground for future feature film leadership.
details.whyItMatters: Shorts are Pixar's talent development pipeline. By giving emerging creators small-scale leadership opportunities, Pixar identifies and develops the directors who will lead future features, building institutional creative depth.
takeaways: Pixar shorts screen before features and have won multiple Academy Awards
They serve as a training ground for emerging directors and animators
The shorts program develops talent who later lead feature film production

faq.question: Which Pixar short films have won Academy Awards?
faq.answer: Pixar has won multiple Best Animated Short Oscars including Geri's Game, For the Birds, One Man Band, and Bao. The shorts program consistently produces some of the finest animated shorts ever made while developing future feature filmmakers.

faq.question: How do Pixar shorts develop future feature directors?
faq.answer: Directing a short teaches filmmakers to manage a team, make creative decisions under pressure, and deliver a complete story. Domee Shi directed the short Bao before helming Turning Red. The shorts program is essentially a directing school within Pixar.
